title: AION 2 Cleric Build: PvE Skills and Healing
description: Prepare a Cleric PvE build with Stigmas, debuff order, healing, cleanse, resurrection, and party adjustments.
summary: Prepare a Cleric PvE build with Stigmas, debuff order, healing, cleanse, resurrection, and party adjustments.
quickAnswer: For party PvE, put a direct heal, cleanse, and resurrection on separate reachable controls, then use Debilitating Mark → Chain of Torment → Earth Punishment and available Condemnation attacks. Equip party protection and Noble Aura when the group needs their benefits; exchange damage for healing if recovery is the problem.

workflow.title: Recover the party without losing the encounter
workflow.caption: Choose the recovery that addresses the damage and cast in a safe window.

steps.label: Check the immediate danger
steps.description: Move or protect yourself if the current mechanic would interrupt or kill you during recovery.

steps.label: Identify the needed response
steps.description: Distinguish ordinary damage, a removable effect, and a dead ally; check what your available skill can address.

steps.label: Stabilize safely
steps.description: Use the needed heal or cleanse, or find a safe resurrection window. Keep these controls outside damage repetition.

steps.label: Resume useful damage
steps.description: Once the party is stable, refresh debuffs and resume available attacks.
